parsed.title: SHORT CIRCUIT
parsed.body:
All [intruder] in each [corridorNWSE] move.
Then, all [intruder] in every Room move.

In Sections with an [oxygen]:
Place a [fire] in each Room with a [malfunction].

Each [robot] in a Room without a [secure]
resolves [ICON: yellow spiked circular field with black creature-like silhouette].
confidentlyVisible: All typography is upright in the file.
The title is printed in white capitals above artwork of an electrical explosion in a damaged technological interior.
Three separate dark-green rules panels appear beneath the artwork.
The first panel contains two curled white exoskeleton icons and one diagonally oriented corridor icon.
The second panel contains a cyan horizontal supply icon, an orange-red flame icon, and a white gear icon.
The third panel contains a white robot icon, a white shield-like icon, and a yellow-and-black glyph.
uncertainties: The final yellow spiked glyph is not confidently represented in the supplied glossary; its morphology is transcribed literally and its meaning is unknown.
